gloss: chance; fate; destiny; twist of fate

definitions.gloss: chance; fate; destiny; twist of fate
definitions.explanation: The way things happen to come together, often attributed to fate or luck rather than planning. Can refer to fortunate or unfortunate coincidences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{出会|であ}った→出会う：02298_deau⟧。
examples.english: I met him through a twist of fate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧な{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせだ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: What a strange coincidence, isn't it?

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせ⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: This might also be some kind of fate.

notes:
FORMS:
{巡|めぐ}り (going around, from ⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧) + {合|あ}わせ (meeting, combining)
Literally: "coming around to meet"

USAGE:
{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせ often implies that events were fated to happen, whether good or bad. It suggests that the circumstances were beyond one's control.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせ - twist of fate, destiny
- ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧な{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせ - strange coincidence
- ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせ - bad luck, unfortunate circumstances

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧ - fate, connection, karma
- ⟦{因縁|いんねん}→因縁：07460_innen⟧ - fate, karma, destiny
- ⟦{宿命|しゅくめい}→宿命：07401_shukumei⟧ - destiny, fate (predetermined)
- ⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧ - coincidence (more neutral, less fated)

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in both casual and literary contexts.
